items.reason: Already covered: every `${{ }}` in agent-review.yml is an `env:` binding, blocking rules P5/P7 in scripts/actions-pin.mjs fail any expression spliced into a `run:` body or any github.event.* outside `env:`, and test-unit/workflow-injection.test.mjs asserts both the tree and the rules — so the only change left would be editing the workflow to satisfy a regex detector.

Needs network: pinning 25 refs means resolving each tag to the commit it points at right now, and a fabricated SHA breaks CI rather than pinning it; the close is one networked run of `npm run actions:pin`, which already rewrites the workflows AND flips STRICT/RATCHET.pinned in the same pass.

lessons: This repository answers a D9 finding with a blocking script plus a unit test that asserts the script still evaluates the rule — check scripts/*.mjs and test-unit/ for an existing gate before treating a scanner hit as an open gap; workflow-injection.test.mjs and workflow-triggers.test.mjs already cover the script-injection and privileged-trigger classes.

Action pinning here is deliberately one atomic networked command: `npm run actions:pin` resolves the digests, rewrites the workflows, and writes STRICT = true / RATCHET.pinned back into scripts/actions-pin.mjs, because pins that nothing enforces come undone on the next Dependabot bump. Half of it offline is worse than none.

`.github/workflows/` is a CODEOWNERS law file, so the usual offline consolation prize for a supply-chain item (add a scheduled burn-down workflow) is itself out of bounds and would need write scopes plus an unpinned third-party action.
